reviewed_by: Codex focused review of completion-hook goal routing
reason: Core now bounds replayable required completion-hook rechecks for running goals, preserves the final rejected answer, and pauses a persistently blocked goal. Seven exact Python cases cover acceptance on the second recheck, persistent rejection with and without tools, the streamed provider-turn finalizer, ordinary-turn behavior, and delivery of hook feedback.
exclusions: No UI, frontend, native, browser-origin, or packaged-client code changed. Those test layers and unrelated backend journeys are excluded. The selected Python cases exercise the Core state transition and hook subprocess through a local provider fixture; live production Core and browser behavior require separate verification before a production completion claim.
